text_block_list.text: In the morning, right around start time—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait for meeeeee! Don't close the 
gateeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, it is not fine... There are two of 
them...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of all things, both of the alarm clocks I 
set every night ran out of battery at the 
same time...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I thought I prepared a backup for the 
backup, but it seems I needed yet another. 
Next time, I should also verify its 
operation before going to sleep and—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My thanks! Ngh! I wonder if I'll make it 
to the classroom just in time...!

Her usual intellectual composure was 
nowhere to be seen. With her hair in 
complete disarray, Biwa Hayahide ran off 
toward the school building.
